paper.title: Spatial patterns for discrete models of diffusion in excitable media

headline: Greenberg-Hastings 1978 excitable-media CA: 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; broken front -> spiral rotating at period 6 (T=5) over 37 rotations; head-on fronts annihilate in 4 steps with no pass-through; finite critical size increasing with r (r=4:L_c=4, r=8:L_c=8, r=12:L_c=12)

verdicts.gate: P1 rotating spiral: broken front -> persistent spiral, rotation period = T=5 (+-1) stable over >= 20 rotations
P2 wavefront annihilation: head-on fronts annihilate (band -> 0 within one refractory period T=5) with NO transmitted front
P3 refractory-set critical size: finite L_c (dies < 5 cyc below, persists > 100 cyc at/above) increasing monotonically with r

extra.framing: 3-state excitable cellular automaton (synchronous local rule on a 2D grid), not agent-stepping — CA (disclosed)
extra.note_period: the discrete GH spiral's global-activity rotation period is T=1+r to within +-1; at r=4 it measures T+1=6 (a known one-tick discrete-core delay), inside the locked +-1 tolerance
extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published excitable-media CA; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + lock-first discipline reproduce the Greenberg-Hastings signatures (a fixed-period rotating spiral, wavefront annihilation, and a refractory-set critical re-entry size) and would catch an artifact

citations: Greenberg, J.M. & Hastings, S.P. (1978). Spatial patterns for discrete models of diffusion in excitable media. SIAM Journal on Applied Mathematics 34(3):515-523. doi:10.1137/0134040.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction graded against the Greenberg-Hastings signatures (rotating-spiral period, wavefront annihilation, critical size)
